name: Economic development has greatly improved people’s living standards.
trans: 经济发展极大地提高了人们的生活水平。

name: Technological innovation is an important driving force of economic growth.
trans: 科技创新是经济增长的重要动力。

name: The digital economy has created many new jobs.
trans: 数字经济创造了许多新就业岗位。

name: Online shopping has become a popular form of consumption.
trans: 网上购物已成为一种流行的消费方式。

name: E-commerce brings convenience to both consumers and businesses.
trans: 电子商务给消费者和企业都带来便利。

name: Consumers should spend money wisely and avoid overspending.
trans: 消费者应理性消费，避免过度消费。

name: The cost of living in big cities is relatively high.
trans: 大城市的生活成本相对较高。

name: Young people often face great financial pressure.
trans: 年轻人常常面临很大的经济压力。

name: The government has taken measures to stabilize prices.
trans: 政府已采取措施稳定物价。

name: Economic globalization brings both opportunities and challenges.
trans: 经济全球化既带来机遇，也带来挑战。

name: International trade promotes economic cooperation between countries.
trans: 国际贸易促进国家间的经济合作。

name: We should pursue sustainable economic development.
trans: 我们应追求可持续的经济发展。

name: Economic growth should not come at the cost of the environment.
trans: 经济增长不应以环境为代价。

name: Small and medium-sized enterprises play an important role in the economy.
trans: 中小企业在经济中发挥重要作用。

name: Only by improving productivity can companies remain competitive.
trans: 只有提高生产力，公司才能保持竞争力。
